channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Next.js 16.3: Instant Navigations, Up to 90% Less Dev Memory and Faster Builds
item.description: Vercel has released Next.js 16.3, featuring significant updates since version 16.0. Enhancements include reduced memory usage during development, accelerated build times, and improved type checking. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Why Fetch When You Can Sync? Building Local-First Apps on a Sync Engine Architecture
item.description: James Arthur shares why sync is the next frontier in frontend architecture. He explains how extending reactivity to the server with Electric and TanStack DB replaces imperative fetching with declarative data bindings. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: 20× the CI traffic without getting slower: How we rebuilt Git serving at Datadog
item.description: Learn how Datadog built gitretriever to handle 20× more CI Git traffic while maintaining low latency and reducing backend CPU usage. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Harper Argues Against the Multi-System Stack and Releases 5.2
item.description: The database platform Harper advocates for a single-runtime architecture that keeps application code and data together, with its benchmark against a Vercel-based stack reporting significantly better performance on live, personalized-data… (1 source: infoq)

item.title: capri: Type-safe, atomic Gleam bindings for Khepri, the modern distributed database for the BEAM
item.description: Type-safe atomic Gleam bindings for Khepri, the modern distributed database for the BEAM. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: A revisit of remote Spectre attacks on Cloudflare Workers
item.description: In 2024 and 2025, we reassessed remote Spectre attacks on our Workers infrastructure. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: The Open-Sourcing of DeepSeek Harness Opens the Door to Modular, Unbundled AI Agent Infrastructure
item.description: DeepSeek has released a developer preview of DeepSeek Harness (dsh), an open-source execution runtime for building autonomous AI agents. The software features a micro-kernel architecture with modular plugins for various functional units. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Whatsapp Tests on Device ML for Scam Detection with Privacy Preserving Analytics
item.description: WhatsApp is testing Scam Alert in limited beta, using on device machine learning to detect potential scam messages from non contacts. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Managing your work
item.description: If you’re juggling multiple Copilot sessions, use the My work pane to track what's in flight, what's done, and what's next. The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Managing your work appeared first on The GitHub Blog . (1 source: githubblog)
